decisions.title: P10 / P11 Security Sequencing
decisions.decision: P10 backend development may proceed later as a project-local, non-network-exposed application/service boundary. P10 MUST NOT expose a production/public/network-facing API or backend surface until the required authentication, CSRF protection, rate limiting, and other applicable security controls have been implemented and authorized through the appropriate security phase. P10 requirements and architecture MUST explicitly preserve this boundary. No assumption is authorized that P10 may expose an insecure public backend merely because P10 is independently listed from P11 in the roadmap. If the exact boundary between 'local/non-network-exposed' and 'network-exposed' needs machine enforcement, that requirement must be made explicit during P10 requirements/architecture. The security controls themselves are NOT implemented now.

Defers all authentication, CSRF, rate limiting and related control implementation to the security phase

decisions.title: P8 / P10 Presentation Ownership
decisions.decision: P8 owns CMS/domain content semantics; the Content / Section / ContentType models; content persistence; authorization semantics; publishing workflow; asset semantics; and the CMS output-safety boundary. P8 remains headless and does not own the actual frontend rendering/presentation implementation. P10 owns domain/frontend/, actual presentation/rendering, frontend composition, rendered HTML output, the serving/presentation surface, domain/backend/ within the security boundary defined by D-P10-1, and domain/shared/ for shared vertical-slice contracts. P10 also owns the interpretation and registry of Section.layout values. P8 may continue storing Section.layout as CMS data, but P8 does not define the presentation meaning of those values. CMS ownership must not be duplicated inside P10.

decisions.title: Frontend Technology Selection
decisions.decision: TECH-FE-STRING-COMPOSITION is SELECTED as the P10 rendering technology. P10 will use project-local plain string composition to generate static/server-rendered HTML, with mandatory per-sink output encoding. The implementation must reuse the already-approved security boundaries established by P8 and P9, including P8's html.escape(text, quote=True), P9's _safe_attr(), and P9's escape_json_ld_for_html(). The renderer must produce the build-directory shape consumed by the P9 audit: **/*.html, robots.txt and sitemap.xml. The technology selection does NOT authorize implementation.

decisions.title: Slice Field-Slots Contract — Declared Slots Must Exactly Match Layout-Consumed Slots
decisions.decision: A slice's cms_content_references[].field_slots array must contain exactly the slot names consumed by the selected layout, with set equality (order-insensitive). Duplicate declared slots are invalid. Under-declared, over-declared, and unsupported slots are rejected. The comparison is between the slice's declared field_slots and the layout's consumed slots as defined by the authoritative layout registry (domain/frontend/layout_registry.py). The existing authoritative ContentType validation and content-slot resolution (domain/frontend/content_slots.py) remain in force. No new field-slot namespace or implicit slot auto-completion is introduced.
approved_scope: A slice's cms_content_references[].field_slots must exactly match the layout's consumed slots via set equality: set(declared) == set(layout_consumed).
Order of declared slots is not semantically significant; comparison is set-based.
Duplicate slot entries in a single field_slots declaration are rejected (schema enforces uniqueItems: true).
Under-declared slots (slice omits a slot the layout consumes) are rejected: missing = layout_consumed - declared.
Over-declared slots (slice declares a slot the layout does not consume) are rejected: extra = declared - layout_consumed.
Unsupported slots (slots not in the authoritative _HOME_SLOT_SOURCE mapping) are rejected by the existing content_slots contract and must be rejected by the slice schema and gate.
The authoritative layout_registry._LAYOUT_SPEC defines the consumed slots for each layout. Currently only 'home-default' is registered, consuming ('heading', 'body').

The existing authoritative content_slots contract (_HOME_SLOT_SOURCE = {'heading': 'title', 'body': 'body'}) remains the value-binding authority. The gate continues to call resolve_content_slots with the declared slots.
The existing authoritative layout_registry.resolve() validation (declared slots must exist in ContentType) remains in force.
The slice schema p10-slice.schema.json is updated to add uniqueItems: true to field_slots and the description is updated to reflect the exact-match requirement.
conditions: This decision does NOT authorize Phase B (slice implementation, renderer, deployment, or network exposure).
This decision does NOT modify the P8 CMS, P9 audit, P17 state machine, or any P8/P9/P17 artifact.

This decision does NOT resolve the M-4 declared-vs-consumed semantic ambiguity in any way other than the exact-match rule stated above; any future layout beyond 'home-default' must follow the same rule.
This decision does NOT authorize slice implementation, Content publication, runtime-gate implementation beyond the field-slot contract, deployment, or network exposure.

The REQ-P10-09 runtime validation gate's check_layout_slot_conformance control is the enforcement point for this contract. The gate must obtain consumed slots from the layout registry and compare with the slice's declared slots using set equality.
The existing ContentType validation (declared slots must exist in ContentType) and content-slot resolution (values must be non-empty strings) remain in force and are not weakened by this decision.
No new field-slot namespace is introduced; the declared and consumed slots refer to the same concept defined by the layout registry and content_slots authority.
The slice schema p10-slice.schema.json is updated to add uniqueItems: true to field_slots and the description is updated to reflect the exact-match requirement against the layout's consumed slots.

This decision modifies the schema (p10-slice.schema.json), the runtime gate (check_layout_slot_conformance), and the test suite (regression tests for the new contract). No other files are modified by this decision.
